hooks.name: Legend source guard
hooks.description: When the agent edits the Ghost Walk tour data, re-state the honesty rules and ask it to keep every legend cited before it continues.

action.prompt: You just edited the Ghost Walk tour data. Check every stop: a legend must say "legend says" in its story and cite at least one public source with a working URL and an accessed date; history must cite a source; anything without a confirmed source must be kind "fiction", set in a public space (never a home or a business), and say it was invented for this walk. Stops at homes or residences need an etiquette note asking walkers to stay on the public sidewalk. Then run `npm test` (apps/ghost-walk/test/tour.test.ts checks these rules).
